body: ac-01+ac-02 complete 2026-06-10. Rule: header_hint_postal_veto beside the coord veto in apply_header_sharpen; helpers header_corroborates_postal (token-aware, locale terms, deliberately NOT delegating to header_hint whose substring matcher treats zipper/gzip as postal) + values_look_like_generic_integers (bare ints, leading zero BLOCKS the veto). 4 new tests; full workspace green (857 tests, clippy -D warnings, fmt) — also cleared 19 pre-existing clippy-1.94 lints (useless_vec x14, ptr_arg, complex type, loop-index, from_ref, doc-comment) that would have tripped the pre-push mirror. GOLD VERDICT: 25 flips, 25 fixed, 0 regressed, 0 neutral — postal precision 0.133->0.667 (FP 26->2), recall 1.000 held, headline 0.655->0.682 (+2.7pp). The 26th FP (iucr, leading-zero numeric_code) correctly untouched by the leading-zero guard. ac-03 sample pass running (patched binary, 33,250 stratified files).

ac-03 GATE: GO, zero triggers (gate_postal-veto.json; patched-binary sample pass over 33,250 stratified files). Postal at corpus scale: emissions 31,799->7,412 (-77%), contra_in 0, contra_out 282. TRANSPARENCY NOTE: the oracle disputes 282 removed columns (its postal confirmation is value-schema-only — bare 4-5 digit ints pass zip patterns, which IS the measured disease); gold (human-verified) shows postal recall 1.000 held. Per 0095 the oracle is directional, gold canonical. Residual risk accepted: genuinely-postal columns with non-postal headers would be demoted — bounded by the Precision Principle and demotion-only design. Large movers in the report are cumulative 0.6.24-0.6.26 shipped changes vs the older baseline parquet, each previously gated.
